status: UNMEASURED TEMPLATE NOT USABLE FOR NAVIGATION
notes: Replace dimensions with the actual camera capture size.
Use corners on an existing flat tiled wall or another measured fixed surface. Do not install house markers.
Supply at least 12 different views with at least 12 matched corners per view.
Each view has surface_points_m as XYZ triples and image_points_px as UV pairs.
Surface coordinates use its local XY plane with Z equal to zero.
The final three views are reserved for a separate pixel check.
Pixel checks do not prove a real position accuracy bound.
